dataset.edition_title: BCA Good Industry Practices — Trade List
dataset.generated_by: extraction from BCA GIP guide titles (17 guides)

provenance.document_source: BCA Good Industry Practices (CONQUAS Enhancement Series)
provenance.note: Each trade ties back to a specific GIP guide PDF containing the authoritative workmanship criteria for that trade.

review.review_notes: GIP guides are updated periodically — re-check BCA publications page when new edition indicated by a guide title or date change.

items.name: Ceramic Tiling
items.description: Ceramic and porcelain tile installation on floors and walls. Covers substrate prep, adhesive, grouting, movement joints.

items.name: Natural Stone Finishes
items.description: Marble, granite and other natural stone finishes. Substrate, fixing, sealing, and polishing.

items.name: Painting
items.description: Paint application — surface prep, primer, topcoat, drying, touch-up.

items.name: Waterproofing for External Wall
items.description: External wall waterproofing. Applies to External Finishes (Phase 2 component).

items.name: Aluminium Window
items.description: Aluminium window installation — frame, pane, sealant, operation.

items.name: Timber Doors
items.description: Timber door installation — frame, leaf, ironmongery, alignment.

items.name: Timber Flooring
items.description: Solid timber flooring — substrate, fixing, finishing.

items.name: Engineered Wood Flooring
items.description: Engineered wood flooring — click-lock or glued installation.

items.name: Vinyl Flooring
items.description: Vinyl flooring — roll, tile, and plank (LVT) installation.

items.name: Wardrobes & Kitchen Cabinets
items.description: Built-in carpentry — wardrobes, kitchen cabinets, shelving.

items.name: Precast Concrete Elements
items.description: Precast concrete wall/slab elements — jointing, sealing, finishing.

items.name: Drywall Internal Partition
items.description: Drywall internal partition walls and ceilings — framing, boards, jointing, finishing.

items.name: Prefabricated Bathroom Unit (PBU)
items.description: Prefabricated Bathroom Unit — installation, connection, fittings.

items.name: M&E — General
items.description: Mechanical & electrical fittings — switches, outlets, light fittings, fan coil units. No single GIP guide — refer to SS standards + manufacturer specs.

items.name: Design & Materials Selection (advisory)
items.description: High-level quality preferences (Vol 1) + material/system choices (Vol 2). Advisory only — not a trade for assignment; used for specification review.

changelog.summary: Initial extraction — 17 BCA GIP trades + 1 advisory entry, each mapped to typical inspection components.
